g.title: memory_progression
g.text: session memory — the automatic progression of a conversation into durable memory
teal: the pipeline · orange: off-peak scheduling · grey: Postgres · red: failure paths

g.title: cluster_capture
g.text: 1 · CAPTURE — universal: every harness that uses the gateway feeds it, with ZERO client changes

g.title: cluster_sweep
g.text: 2 · SWEEP — the housekeeping loop decides WHAT and WHEN

g.title: cluster_distill
g.text: 4 · DISTILL — automatic MAP-REDUCE: how a multi-megabyte session fits one memory document

g.title: cluster_fail
g.text: Failure semantics — fail SOFT, never lose the session

g.title: canonical
g.text: the sweep's substrate: every turn of every key
(a memory row is never the only copy)

g.title: plain
g.text: plain chat agent (raw SDK, opencode, OWUI)

g.title: gate
g.text: 3 · ATTACHMENT GATE — a CAPABILITY probe, not a config check
the gateway calls the memory server's memory_status tool WITH THE KEY'S OWN CREDENTIALS
NOT attached → 200 {ok:false, inert:true} · nothing runs · nothing is spent

g.title: offpeak
g.text: a distill runs only while the SUMMARIZER
MODEL's own evaluator reports low demand

g.title: knobs
g.text: admin knobs: summarizer model (default = the caller's routing)
quiet window · output cap · runtime enable

g.title: contract
g.text: the output contract (recall compatibility, prompt_version stamped)
## Playbook — fenced JSON, only when the trace carries ≥ MIN_TOOL_CALLS
clean tool calls; the outcome label is INFERRED (or stamped unverified)

g.title: write
g.text: with the KEY'S OWN dataset credentials (per-key override, last-wins)
metadata: kind = project-summary | session_history · session_id · prompt_version

g.title: rawfb
g.text: MODEL failure after the gates passed
rawFallback = true (app default): write the raw
transcript as session_history — never lost, but
false (shipped G2 example): leave the row due and
retry — the canonical store still holds it

g.title: cost
g.text: every distill LLM call settles ONE ledger row
against the owning key + a phase=distill agent trace

g.title: store
g.text: mm-rag memory dataset — the key's long-term memory

g.title: recall
g.text: 6 · RECALL — the next session's agent retrieves it
(that is the whole payoff: the memory is the project's own history)

g.title: legend
g.text: automatic — no client call, no harness plugin
scheduling only — the summarizer's own demand state
soft, attributed, and never a lost session
